newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Evli ups Nokia to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Evli ups Nokia to buy.

text.p: Finnish brokerage Evli Securities said in a research note dated March 3 it had raised its recommendation on Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy to "buy" from outperform, and it set a target price of 370 markka.
"Our target price for Nokia is 370 markka and due to recent share price drop, we raise recommendation to BUY," Evli said.
At 1440/1240 GMT, Nokia's A-share traded at 308.00 markka, up 11.00 markka.
The share's all-time high is 340.00 markka set on September 15, 1995.

Evli said Nokia's CEO Jorma Ollila would meet investors in the United States and Britain on March 3-6. "As investors and analysts are likely to update their forecasts after the meetings, we believe that trading activity in Nokia's shares increases during the weeks to follow," it said.

Evli added it had upgraded its earnings forecasts for Nokia after the release of the group's 1996 results. It now projected 1997 EPS at 15.27 markka and 1998 EPS at 18.49 markka from 10.69 markka last year.
Evli said Nokia's net sales would rise to 48.8 billion markka this year and further to 60.1 billion in 1998 from 39.3 billion in 1996.
